scope: Pinned VACE flower-task LoRA training preflight only
summary: The corrected preflight verifies the physical GPU, dataset, pinned DiffSynth source, and all required checkpoint files with immutable hashes.
evidence: Physical A800 GPU 1 was selected with 81225 MiB free for a rank-4, 256x448x17 configuration.
DiffSynth commit b1c02ce76aabc989f6bf534756b2da84532249e5 and four VACE checkpoint hashes are recorded.
lessons: Trainer provenance must be validated as an acceptance output rather than inferred from installed packages.
limitations: This validates readiness only; it is not adapter-quality evidence.
